cards.card_text: Isaiah's words: "Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised." Hang on to that line, friend.
cards.verse_text: Aram from the east and Philistia from the west have devoured Israel with open mouths. Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised.

cards.card_text: And there's that line again: "Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised."
cards.verse_text: Therefore the Lord takes no pleasure in their young men; He has no compassion on their fatherless and widows. For every one of them is godless and wicked, and every mouth speaks folly. Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised.

cards.card_text: And for the THIRD time: "Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised."
cards.verse_text: Manasseh devours Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh; together they turn against Judah. Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised.

cards.card_text: And one more time: "Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised." That's FOUR times, friend, and I spent years counting dust in a junk drawer, so trust me, I counted.
cards.verse_text: Nothing will remain but to crouch among the captives or fall among the slain. Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised.
